decidedBy: independent non-author reconciler, fresh Claude subagent (Claude Opus 5.5); did not author the page or either critic report

decisions.rationale: Accept. Fixed on the page side: the recap heading is now "Now install on your own computer", exactly the heading coding-lab/README.md line 12 names, so the lab-to-setup hand-off lands without a lab edit (and without re-staling lab critic/solved-run bindings). The README phrase "numbered steps for macOS, Linux and Windows" remains accurate: the section is a numbered list covering each OS, with steps that link to the official vendor guides per the course-owner product decision. Round-2 education recheck marks it resolved.

Accept; partly fixed, still open at low impact, does not block release (medium at filing, now Windows-only). Fixed: step 3 has a completion check ("Done when mvn -v prints a Maven version in the next step") and the cheat-sheet note now says only the Temurin installer sets PATH and JAVA_HOME and the learner adds Maven bin to Path. Remaining: a Windows learner gets no route for editing Path and no early stop-and-ask; the troubleshooting line "repeat the guide's PATH step" points to a Maven guide step with no Windows detail. Reproducing OS Path-editing steps is excluded by the product decision, so the minimal fix (recommended in the next correction loop on this module branch, before release if one is run) is one sentence in step 3: "On Windows, if you have not edited Path before, ask your instructor before you continue." The existing general stop-and-ask boundary already catches learners after a failed check.

Accept; still open, medium, does not block release of the HTML page. The defect is in the derived artifact.md companion: md-from-html.mjs drops href targets, so link-text-only references (per-OS Temurin guides, Maven download page, IntelliJ IDEA SDKs page, Sources list) lose their addresses. The HTML now also prints plain-text addresses for the Temurin releases page, the Maven install guide and the JetBrains installation guide, which will survive derivation. The remaining fix is repository tooling (keep link targets as Markdown [text](url) in md-from-html.mjs), which AGENTS.md Delivery puts outside this module-scoped branch: fix it on a tooling branch, then regenerate artifact.md here and have the critics recheck the regenerated companion before it is bound. No course-owner decision is needed.

Accept; still open, low, does not block release. Hint placement under the Markdown "## Cheat sheet" heading is md-from-html.mjs derivation behaviour, not page content; neither the HTML nor the page-build sources need to change. Fix on the same tooling branch as edu-install-design-003 (emit each data-pep-hint with its activity, or omit hints from the cheat-sheet section), then regenerate artifact.md and recheck.

Accept. Activity 2 step 4 now reads "A failed command shows an error message; read it and try again", and unsupported java/javac/mvn arguments print a message naming the three commands available in this practice terminal, consistent with the simulation notice. Round-2 education recheck marks it resolved.

Accept. Evidence is official (Adoptium Windows MSI guide: x64 only; Adoptium API 404 for JDK 25 windows/aarch64). Step 1 no longer maps ARM-based Windows to aarch64; it states the Temurin Windows installer supports only x64 and tells ARM-based Windows learners to ask the instructor before continuing. macOS/Linux aarch64 guidance unchanged and correct. Round-2 SME recheck marks it resolved.

Accept. Temurin publishes JRE 25 builds, so the page must say JDK. Step 2 now says to choose package type JDK, not JRE; line 481 says a JRE can only run programs and some download pages still offer one; predict option b feedback no longer implies a runtime-only download is impossible. Round-2 SME recheck marks it resolved on the HTML; the stale artifact.md text is covered by the pre-release regeneration.
Accept. The simulated mvn -v locale line now ends ", time zone: Etc/UTC", matching the Maven 3.10.0 sample output shape on maven.apache.org/install.html. Round-2 SME recheck marks it resolved.

Accept. The practice terminal now accepts only java -version (the form the page teaches); java --version falls through to the accurate "Only java -version, javac -version and mvn -v are available" message, so no unverified --version output remains. Round-2 SME recheck marks it resolved.
